Appearance:
 Shri Sarvesh Kumar Jaiswal - Advocate for the appellant  Miss Samta Jain- G.A for the State.
 Shri Dharmendra Kumar Shah, learned counsel for the obj  ORDER

This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.113/2024 registered at Police Station Damua, District - Chhindwara for the offences punishable under Sections 376-D and 392 of IPC and Sections 3 (2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 07.05.2024.
Prosecution story, in brief, is that at the alleged date, time and place, appellant established physical relations with prosecutrix, aged about 24 years without her consent and against her will.
Learned counsel for the appellant Vishal Markam submits that appellant was not present at the scene of incident.
He has been falsely implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix herself has filed an affidavit to the effect that present appellant was not present at the scene of incident.
Further, DNA report does not support the prosecution case so far as present appellant Vishal Markam is concerned.
He NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50872 2 CRA-10382-2024 further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
Learned counsel for the Objector has no objection, if the appellant is released on bail.
Having regard to nature of evidence available on record with respect to present appellant including DNA report, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.

It is directed that appellant- Vishal Markam be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
